question:
The figure is an aerial photo of a parking lot. Overlay a 8x8 grid on the image: cell (r, c) means row r counting from the top and column c counting from the left, both 1-based. Exactly one grid cell contains exactly one car (by car centre). Scan the grid systematically — which cell is it?
(A) (2, 8)
(B) (2, 7)
(C) (6, 1)
(D) (5, 8)

Answer with only the correct option letter.
